rows.title: Germinal products notifications have their own Upload documents page
rows.detail: Germinal products is its own set in the animals frontend, and each of its pages is a copy of the matching live animals page, taken once that page has been built. Upload documents is one of the germinal set's pages. A trader working on a germinal products notification needs the same place to attach a health certificate and the other documents a consignment needs, with the same guidance, the same four fields, the same virus-scan statuses, listing and download, and the same removal through a 'Delete this document?' confirmation page, with that notification's documents kept apart from any live animals notification's. The germinal data fields list names no germinal-specific document fields, so the copy asks exactly what the live animals page asks.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal products notification, the overview's 'Upload documents' task opens a page headed 'Upload documents' with the caption 'Documents', the fields Document reference, Document type, Date of issue and Attachment in that order inside a 'File upload' card with a 'Save and add another' button, and 'Save and continue', 'Save and return to overview' and 'Cancel and return to overview' at the foot of the page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-011, -p1-013; repo:frontend src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents)

On a germinal products notification, the Upload documents page opens with 'You must attach a health certificate if this consignment requires one. If you do not have it now, you can add it later. All documents should be uploaded before the consignment arrives at the UK port. Documents must be in English and you must upload all pages.', then 'Other documents you may need to attach include:' with the bullets 'import licences or authorisations' and 'commercial documents or invoices', and an expander 'Check which additional documents you must upload' holding the additional-documents table. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p10-015, -p10-016; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-104; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

On a germinal products notification, the Document type list offers 'Select one' and then, in this order, 'ITAHC (Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate)', 'Other veterinary certificate / veterinary declaration', 'Self-declaration', 'Journey log', 'Import permit / authorisation', 'CITES permit/certificate', 'Air waybill', 'Sea waybill', 'Rail waybill', 'Bill of lading', 'Commercial invoice', 'Packing list / species list' and 'Other supporting documents'. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p4-084; repo:frontend src/server/app/services/document-types)

On a germinal products notification, the Attachment field's hint reads 'Your file must be:' with the bullets 'files that are smaller than 50MB', 'PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPEG, JPG, PNG, XLS or XLSX', 'up to a maximum of 15 files' and 'ZIP files are not allowed for security reasons'. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; repo:frontend src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents)

On a germinal products notification, a document added with the reference 'ITAHC-001', a document type, a date of issue and a PDF file is listed with a 'Scanning for virus' tag and then a 'Check completed' tag, its 'View file' link downloads the file that was attached, and it is still listed after the page is reloaded. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 TRACE C actions 92-95)

On a germinal products notification, 'Save and add another' with nothing entered shows an error summary titled 'There is a problem' listing, in order, 'Enter a document reference', 'Select a document type', 'Enter a date of issue' and 'Upload a document', each repeated inline on its own field. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p22-068)

On a germinal products notification, each listed document's 'Remove' link reads 'Remove' followed by visually hidden text giving that document's reference, such as 'Remove ITAHC-001'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p10-084; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

On a germinal products notification, following a listed document's 'Remove' link opens a page whose browser title is 'Delete this document? - Import notification service - GOV.UK', headed 'Delete this document?', with the inset text 'This will remove the document from this notification.', then a summary list with the rows 'Document reference', 'Document type' with the type's name, 'Date of issue' as day/month/year and 'File' with the attached file's name, none with a change link, then 'This action cannot be undone.' (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-127, -p3-128, -p3-129, -p3-130, -p3-131; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p10-094 to -p10-098; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

On a germinal products notification, the 'Delete this document?' page ends with a red 'Yes, delete' button and, beside it, a 'No, cancel' link; 'No, cancel' and the page's Back link each return to Upload documents with the document still listed. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p10-091, -p10-099, -p10-100; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-132, -p3-133; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p10-065, -p10-066)

On a germinal products notification, pressing 'Yes, delete' returns to Upload documents with the add form empty and no success banner, where that document is not listed, including after the page is reloaded; with no documents left the page shows no documents table. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p10-101; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-134; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p10-069, -p10-070)

On a germinal products notification with JavaScript turned off, the 'Remove' link opens the 'Delete this document?' page and 'Yes, delete' removes the document and returns to Upload documents. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-066, -p1-073, -p1-075)

A document added on a germinal products notification is not listed on any live animals notification's Upload documents page, and a germinal products notification cannot be opened through the live animals set's Upload documents page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-016, -p1-017)

The germinal products Upload documents page and its 'Delete this document?' page have no serious or critical axe violations (WCAG 2.2 AA): the upload page when empty, in its error state and with a saved document that has scanned clean, and the delete page as it opens. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-062)

notes: One slice only; nothing to combine. Every other documents requirement still to build changes the live animals documents folder, which the split-off documents theme owns (its pointer already holds them in requirements or pickUp), so this area's only row is the germinal copy.

Keeps its existing id inc-179 and its theme, germinal-products. Rewritten on the 27 November re-distil because req-1825 says the copy behaves as every adopted documents requirement says: the opening sentence (req-483), Remove's hidden text (req-536), and the 'Delete this document?' confirmation page with its content, buttons, Back link, outcome and no-JavaScript behaviour (req-535, req-2700 to req-2708, req-2711) now show in the criteria. The delete page's layout (req-2707), stale-document handling (req-2709) and return context (req-2710) come with the copy and are proven on the live page; they are not repeated here to keep the row under about 15 criteria.

Ordering: externalDependsOn should name the documents split workarea's rows that landed the live documents changes, inc-031, inc-034, inc-037 and inc-038, all done. inc-033 and inc-035 are merged-into and never become done, so the combiner replaces them by inc-037 and inc-038. This row must also wait for the documents branch's rows that build its pickUp (req-483, req-535, req-536, req-2700 to req-2711): that branch has not drafted them yet, so once it does, add each as an externalDependsOn here, or the copy would be taken before the live page has them.
Depends on inc-176, which creates the germinal-products set; the set is not on the frontend's main yet.

The backend's accompanying-document endpoints are keyed by notification reference and need no change for a germinal notification, so backend is not in repos. The end-to-end, accessibility and security specs sit under tests/animals/{e2e,a11y,security}/germinal-products, with page objects beside the other germinal page objects; the security spec drives the germinal documents routes, the delete page included, through the ZAP scan. Criteria assert the page by heading, copy and destination, never by a literal path.
The 50MB limit is already live (documents inc-036 was dropped on 26 October), so the copy carries it as the fourth criterion states.

The save-button rule (Save and return to overview makes the same checks as Save and continue) is owned set-wide by inc-244, so this row carries no save-button criterion. Its navigation (where Save and continue and Back go, the opening run, amend returns) was trimmed on 6 November; EUDPA-774 owns it.

The live animals documents page is signed off (maturity agreed). This row adds a new page in a new set and changes nothing inside the live animals documents folder, so the signed-off check should not trip. If the plan finds the copy cannot be taken without editing that folder, stop and raise it rather than editing it.
Stands alone from inc-181, inc-182, inc-283, inc-184 and inc-185: too much for one plan, the merged row would carry more than about 15 criteria.
Stands alone from inc-183: a different code area, Upload documents against the identified rule, sharing only one spec.
